checks.name: Every file keeps a 112 px hit area
File surfaces repeat 8/8/12/8 padding, 8 gap and 10 radius
Content surfaces hug one or two lines
Menu rows repeat 32 height, 8 radius and 8 horizontal inset
Task panels repeat 12/16 padding and 12 radius
Task title, progress, counts and filenames share the same actual left axis
Task cancel repeats shared control geometry
